title: High-throughput assay for measuring target occupancy of covalent compounds: a case study with MK2
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CB00224A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Julian L. Wong, Mari Manuia, Sandra Gao, Natacha Stoehr, Theresa Boersig, Krystine Vuong, Tao Jiang, Jian Cao, Yong Jia, C. C. King, John Joslin, Leslie Ofori, Jon Loren, Zuni I. Bassi
Two complementary, plate-based assays that overcome the throughput bottleneck associated with measuring target engagement are presented. These methods utilize covalent tracers to probe indirectly the engagement of a covalent inhibitor with MK2.
